$comment: Name this paper's venue preset in "extends": "paperlint:<name>" for a shipped one, e.g. "paperlint:agenticdev" (`npx paperlint --help` lists them), or a path to your own preset relative to THIS file, e.g. "../../venues/my-venue.jsonc"; add "kind" for its page limit. `npx paperlint new <name> --venue <preset>` writes both for a new paper. Until then the page limit, fonts and format are not checked. To track the paper's attempts at venues instead, replace "extends" (and "kind") with a "cycles" list, the venue and kind inside each attempt — beside "cycles", "extends" is refused, even as null (docs/configuration.md, "The paper's cycles").
